entry.title: Gateweave Track 0.51.0
entry.summary: The protocol stays at 31. Open tabs keep their copy. Two workspace migrations (0041 and 0042) run on their own when each workspace wakes. They add the reopen count to signals and the tables that keep panels. There is no D1 migration. Nothing to set. Upload addresses are signed with your existing BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and the files go to the existing FILES bucket. Without a FILES bucket, attach_file answers that this Track keeps no files. Rolling back to 0.50.0 works, since it ignores the new columns and tables. The three panel tools and attach_file go away, and an open panel is not revealed until you update again.

entry.title: Gateweave Agents 0.35.0
entry.summary: Update. pnpm run deploy applies the D1 migration (0013_workspace_deletion, a new table) before the new code goes live. The four registry migrations (0046 to 0049: three new tables and three nullable columns) are in each workspace's registry and run by themselves when the workspace is next used; there is no step for you. Data left by earlier deletions. From the first daily run after the update, a workspace that is gone but still has a location row is taken as deleted, and its objects are deleted. TARGET_RULE still defaults to log. A call with a destination the agent learned only from outside content runs, and the run page counts it. Refusing such calls by default moves to a later release; to refuse them now, set enforce, as "Tool destinations" in docs/self-hosting.md says. SANDBOX_IDLE_MINUTES is optional: unset or mistyped it is 5, and it takes a number above 0 and up to 300. Set 15 to keep the old behaviour. Track run reporting needs a Track that takes run reports, 0.47.0 or later. A report links to the run's page only when BETTER_AUTH_URL is set.

entry.title: Gateweave Track 0.50.0
entry.summary: The protocol goes from 30 to 31. Open tabs reload and sync again. Two workspace migrations (0039 and 0040) run on their own when each workspace wakes. They add the repository to signals and fill it in for attempts claimed before. Rolling back to 0.49.0 works, since it ignores the new column. Attempts claimed meanwhile have no repository after you update again, so the filter leaves them out.

entry.title: Gateweave Agents 0.34.0
entry.summary: Update. The migration is in each workspace's registry and runs by itself when the workspace is next used; there is no step for you. TARGET_RULE decides what happens to a flagged call: log, the default in this release, records it, and enforce refuses it. To refuse now, set enforce; see "Tool destinations" in docs/self-hosting.md.

entry.title: Gateweave Agents 0.33.0
entry.summary: Update. The migration is in each workspace's registry and runs by itself when the workspace is next used; there is no step for you. Old copies. From a week after a move, the daily run erases the old copies, at its next run; a copy it could not erase is tried again the day after. A deployment that never moved its objects into a jurisdiction has nothing to erase.

entry.title: Gateweave Mail 0.4.0
entry.summary: Update. Two D1 migrations (0027_agent_any_recipient, 0028_agent_webhook_hosts), which pnpm run deploy applies before the new code goes live. Each mailbox upgrades its own storage when it is next used. Older mailboxes. A mailbox that holds mail from before Mail indexed every sender checks that mail's sender against the stored original before trusting it. While a check cannot finish, a send to that sender answers 503 for up to an hour, then the sender counts as unknown. An agent under "Never" that wrote to addresses outside these three kinds is refused for those addresses from now on; addresses already on its allowed list still work. Add the others to its list, or turn on "Allow any recipient and webhook host" for it.

entry.title: Gateweave Guard 0.6.1
entry.summary: No migration, variable or secret. Deploy as usual. The hourly run logs reports: with how many connections it reported for and how many events it sent.

entry.title: Gateweave Guard 0.6.0
entry.summary: pnpm run deploy applies the D1 migration (0011_track_connect). Connect Track needs Track 0.45.0 or later, and Guard served over HTTPS. Against an older Track, keep pasting source keys. If you are rotating SECRETS_KEY, wait for a settled=true line from this version before removing the previous key: a line from an older version does not count.

entry.title: Gateweave Guard 0.5.0
entry.summary: pnpm run deploy applies the D1 migration (0010_track_sources). Reporting needs Track 0.44.0 or later. Against an older Track, every event gets a 404, and after seven days Guard stops sending for that connection until a new key is pasted.
